_about: Character bible. One source of truth for every episode. 'look' is the fixed visual description that is pasted into EVERY image prompt where the character appears, so the character stays the same across panels and episodes. 'kids' / 'adults' add style-specific notes. 'svg' holds the parameters used by tools/render_sample_art.py for the sample art.

kids.prompt: bright friendly cartoon illustration for children, modern animated picture-book style, rounded shapes, big expressive eyes, thick clean dark outlines, flat saturated colors with soft cel shading, warm and joyful mood, simple uncluttered background, never scary or gory, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles
kids.negative: text, letters, watermark, speech bubbles, photorealism, gore, horror, creepy faces, extra fingers, European medieval clothing, modern objects
rules: Storms look exciting, not terrifying: big rounded waves, cartoon lightning.
Jesus is always calm and kind; His face is never shown angry.
Every panel leaves the top 25% fairly empty for speech bubbles.

adults.prompt: modern graphic novel panel, cinematic composition, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, confident inked linework with textured digital painting, muted palette of deep teal and warm amber, realistic human proportions, historically accurate first-century Galilee (Jewish clothing, basalt stone houses, wooden fishing boat), emotional realism, film-still framing, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles
adults.negative: text, letters, watermark, speech bubbles, cartoon, anime, chibi, glossy 3D render, gore, European medieval clothing, blond Jesus, modern objects
rules: Real proportions; faces carry the emotion (fear, awe, exhaustion).
Use light as meaning: Jesus is usually the clearest-lit figure without glowing like a superhero.
Camera language: wide establishing shot → medium → close-up → reveal.
Every panel leaves a calm area (sky, wall, water) for speech bubbles.

orthodox.en: Orthodox edition adds a subtle golden cruciform nimbus (halo with a cross) behind the head of Jesus and plain golden halos for saints after Pentecost. The halo is a separate layer, so the same picture serves both editions.
orthodox.ru: В православной версии за головой Иисуса — тонкий золотой крестчатый нимб, у святых (после Пятидесятницы) — простые нимбы. Нимб — отдельный слой, поэтому одна картинка служит обеим версиям.
orthodox.promptAddon: subtle thin golden cruciform halo behind the head of Jesus, in the manner of Byzantine iconography, understated

protestant.en: Protestant edition: no halos; holiness is shown through light, composition and the reactions of other people.
protestant.ru: Протестантская версия: без нимбов; святость передаётся светом, композицией и реакцией людей.

role.en: The Messiah, Son of God; the main character of every episode.
role.ru: Мессия, Сын Божий; главный герой каждого эпизода.

characters.look: Jesus of Nazareth, a Jewish man about 30 years old, olive-brown skin, dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair parted in the middle, short full dark beard, warm dark brown eyes, kind steady expression; cream undyed linen tunic to the ankles, deep blue woolen outer mantle with small blue-and-white tassels at the corners, leather sandals
characters.kids: soft round face, gentle smile, always the calmest person in the scene
characters.adults: strong worker's hands of a carpenter, sun-weathered face, eyes that look directly at people

role.en: Fisherman, the loudest and most impulsive disciple; later the leader of the apostles.
role.ru: Рыбак, самый громкий и порывистый ученик; позже — первый среди апостолов.

characters.look: Simon Peter, a burly Galilean fisherman about 40, very broad shoulders, sun-tanned skin, short curly black hair with grey at the temples, thick bushy grey-black beard, big expressive eyebrows; rough brown knee-length tunic with sleeves rolled up, rope belt, bare forearms
characters.kids: big round body, huge eyebrows that show every emotion
characters.adults: scar on the left forearm from fishing nets, deep laugh lines

role.en: Peter's brother; quiet, brings people to Jesus.
role.ru: Брат Петра; тихий, приводит людей к Иисусу.

characters.look: Andrew, Peter's younger brother, about 35, lean and wiry, tanned skin, long dark hair tied back at the neck, scruffy short beard, thoughtful eyes; faded sage-green tunic, rope belt
characters.adults: calm watchful face, usually standing slightly behind Peter

role.en: Fisherman, one of the three closest disciples; 'Son of Thunder'.
role.ru: Рыбак, один из трёх ближайших учеников; «сын громов».

characters.look: James son of Zebedee, about 28, strong and athletic, olive skin, short straight black hair, short trimmed black beard, intense eyes, strong jaw; rust-orange tunic, leather belt

role.en: James's younger brother; the youngest disciple; later wrote a Gospel.
role.ru: Младший брат Иакова; самый юный ученик; позже написал Евангелие.

characters.look: John son of Zebedee, the youngest disciple, about 18, slim, olive skin, curly black hair, no beard (only light fuzz), large bright eyes, open curious face; sky-blue tunic, simple belt
characters.kids: looks like a big kid, very expressive
characters.adults: youthful but serious, often looking at Jesus

role.en: Former tax collector.
role.ru: Бывший сборщик налогов (мытарь).

characters.look: Matthew Levi, former tax collector, about 35, neat appearance, olive skin, short neat black hair, carefully trimmed beard, finer clothing than the fishermen: deep purple tunic with a woven border, small leather pouch at the belt

role.en: Keeper of the money bag; later betrays Jesus. Never drawn as a monster — he is a real person who made a terrible choice.
role.ru: Хранитель денежного ящика; позже предаёт Иисуса. Не рисуем чудовищем — это реальный человек, сделавший страшный выбор.

characters.look: Judas Iscariot, about 30, olive skin, dark hair to the ears, short dark beard, restless eyes; dark mustard-yellow tunic, money bag at the belt
characters.adults: often at the edge of the frame, partly in shadow

role.en: Prophet in the wilderness who prepares the way.
role.ru: Пророк в пустыне, приготовивший путь Господу.

characters.look: John the Baptist, a wild wilderness prophet about 30, deeply sun-darkened skin, long unkempt dark hair, long untrimmed beard, piercing eyes, lean; rough garment of brown camel hair with a wide leather belt, wooden staff
characters.kids: big wild hair, friendly fiery eyes
characters.adults: gaunt, intense, standing waist-deep in the Jordan

role.en: Follower of Jesus healed by Him; first witness of the resurrection.
role.ru: Последовательница Иисуса, исцелённая Им; первая свидетельница Воскресения.

characters.look: Mary Magdalene, a Jewish woman about 30, olive skin, dark hair under a long deep-red head covering, kind determined face; cream tunic, deep red mantle
characters.adults: strong, grieving and then radiant at the tomb

role.en: Religious teacher; sincere about the Law but often opposed Jesus. Draw with respect, not as a caricature.
role.ru: Учитель Закона; ревностный, но часто противостоял Иисусу. Рисуем с уважением, без карикатуры.

characters.look: a Pharisee, Jewish religious teacher about 55, olive skin, grey beard, white-and-blue striped prayer shawl over the head, small leather phylactery on the forehead, fine white tunic, holding a scroll

role.en: Roman officer; at the cross he says 'Truly this man was the Son of God' (15:39).
role.ru: Римский офицер; у креста говорит: «Истинно Человек Сей был Сын Божий» (15:39).

characters.look: a Roman centurion about 40, tanned skin, clean-shaven, short cropped hair, bronze helmet with a transverse red crest, segmented iron armor over a red tunic, red cloak

role.en: A 12-year-old girl Jesus raises from death (5:21–43); also the template for children around Jesus (10:13–16).
role.ru: Двенадцатилетняя девочка, которую Иисус воскрешает (5:21–43); также образец для детей рядом с Иисусом (10:13–16).

characters.look: a 12-year-old Jewish girl, olive skin, two long dark braids, big bright eyes, simple light-yellow tunic
characters.adults: pale and still, then alive and laughing

role.en: Father of James and John, owner of a fishing boat with hired men.
role.ru: Отец Иакова и Иоанна, хозяин рыбацкой лодки с работниками.

characters.look: Zebedee, an old Galilean fisherman about 65, weathered skin, short grey hair, long grey-white beard, slate-blue work tunic, strong hands

role.en: Healed of a fever, she immediately serves (1:29–31).
role.ru: Исцелённая от горячки, она сразу начинает служить (1:29–31).

characters.look: Simon Peter's mother-in-law, Galilean woman about 60, olive skin, grey hair under a plum-purple head covering, cream tunic, kind tired face

role.en: Expert in the Law who teaches by quoting earlier authorities. Respectful portrayal.
role.ru: Знаток Закона, который учит, ссылаясь на авторитеты. Без карикатуры.

characters.look: a Jewish scribe about 45, olive skin, full dark beard, white prayer shawl over the head, fine off-white tunic, ink case at the belt, holding a scroll

role.en: Outcast healed by Jesus' touch (1:40–45).
role.ru: Изгой, исцелённый прикосновением Иисуса (1:40–45).

characters.look: a man with leprosy about 40, thin, pale blotched skin, unkempt grey-brown hair and beard, torn grey garments, bandaged hands, face half covered; after healing the same man with clear skin

role.en: Carried by four friends and lowered through the roof (2:1–12).
role.ru: Его принесли четверо друзей и спустили через крышу (2:1–12).

characters.look: a paralysed man about 30, thin legs, olive skin, short dark hair and beard, simple off-white tunic, lying on a woven straw mat

places.look: the Sea of Galilee, a freshwater lake about 21 km long surrounded by brown hills, sudden violent storms caused by cold wind falling from the hills

first-century Galilee fishing boat about 8 m long and 2.3 m wide, wooden planks, one square sail, raised stern with a small steering platform and a cushion, room for about 13 people (modelled on the real 'Ancient Galilee Boat' found in 1986)
Capernaum, a fishing town on the north shore, houses of black basalt stone with flat roofs of beams and clay, a white limestone synagogue
Herod's Temple in Jerusalem, massive pale limestone walls, colonnades, gold details glinting in the sun
the Jordan River winding through the dry Judean wilderness, reeds and tamarisk bushes on the banks, ochre hills
a dusty road between Galilean villages, stone walls, olive trees, distant blue lake
a field of ripe golden barley in Galilee in spring, a footpath through it, low stone boundary walls
